plugin.tsapi.intro: Apps that work with TorrServer (Lampa, Seena and others) see Silo as a TorrServer: torrents chosen in the app are added to Silo and play from Silo.
plugin.tsapi.limits: Magnet links and hashes can be added; a result with only a link to a .torrent file cannot (yet). Transcoding through TorrServer (GStreamer) is not available: the app plays the file as it is.
plugin.tsapi.pass_none: No password: anyone in your network can add torrents through this address.
plugin.tsapi.pass_set: A password is set: the app has to send it.
plugin.tsapi.step1: In the app, open its TorrServer settings.
plugin.tsapi.step2: Enter this address as the TorrServer address.
plugin.tsapi.step3: If you set a login and password below, enter the same in the app.
plugin.tsapi.step4: Pick a torrent in the app: it appears in Silo's library.
plugin.tsapi.title: TorrServer API
plugin.tsapi.token_hint: Only needed when Silo has an owner password: playback goes through Silo's own stream address, which then needs that user's player token. Empty fields keep what is saved.
